posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
Hi all,
I'm looking for a small, lightweight Plugin that would improve the default F9 debugger menu.
There are a bunch of tools out there with dozens of options, but none of them actually improved the handling of Switches and Variables (or comes with other issues).
The original debugger menu of RMMZ has two big issues for me:
* Switches and Variables are in one list combined, making scrolling a pain.
* Variable values can only be edited by clicking up/down by 1 or 10.
The RPG Maker 2000 had a better attempt. Switches and Variables where separated. Also you could click enter on variables and select the new value rather than clicking up or down.
So ...
My requests would be this:
* Modify the default F9 Debugger Menu
* Keep the layout intact (scrolling through batches of 10).
* Game should still pause, when opening the F9 menu.
* Separate the lists of Switches and Variables (use "left" and "right" direction keys to switch between them)
* Enable Enter on a Variable to open an input field to type in the new value number (in addition to the default behavior).
* Make sure, the plugin can handle Text in variables. I don't need the option to change/enter text, but it shouldn't crash or corrupt data, if a variable contains text already.
* If possible: Enable the F9 menu, while a textbox is active (currently by default it's not possible).
I don't need any additional features.
If that would be possible, I'd be really grateful.
Thank you!
